name: ungovernable-governor
description: Ungovernable Governor is a repository used to easily deploy OpenZeppelin Governor and ERC-20 token with safe defaults

scripts.deploy:test: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts deploy:test
scripts.deploy:prod: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts deploy:prod
scripts.init:test: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts init:test
scripts.init:prod: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts init:prod
scripts.mock_upgrade:test: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts mock_upgrade:test
scripts.mock_upgrade:prod: forge clean && forge build && ts-node ts-scripts/run-with-debug.ts mock_upgrade:prod
scripts.report: forge coverage --no-match-test testFuzz --report lcov && perl -pi -e 's|#!/usr/bin/perl5.30|#!/usr/bin/perl|' $(which genhtml 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/Cellar/lcov/*/libexec/bin/genhtml) && genhtml -o report --branch-coverage lcov.info && rm lcov.info

scripts-comments.debug-mode: To enable debug mode, add the --debug flag to any command. Example: 'pnpm deploy:test --debug'
